title: Anomalous scaling limit of a Brownian particle in a log-correlated potential
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of the paper "Anomalous scaling limit of a Brownian particle in a log-correlated potential" by Armstrong, Bou-Rabee and Kuusi: the subdiffusive scaling limit of a Brownian particle whose drift is the gradient of a log-correlated random potential (Theorem A, in its introduction form and in its precise quenched form), quantitative homogenization of the Dirichlet problem uniformly in the infrared cutoff (Theorem B), and large-scale Hölder regularity with a Liouville theorem (Theorem C), together with the supporting coarse-graining, elliptic-regularity and Markov-process…
